## Directions

*Reflect on your overall learning in the course and answer the following questions. Responses to all questions should total about 1-2 pages in length. We will discuss them in person on August 20th, 2025 (sign-up for a time slot [here](https://calendar.notion.so/meet/vsass/yz1yh74okl))*

:::

\vspace{5mm}

1.	Looking back over the quarter, what are you most proud of in your learning or growth?
2.	What’s one challenge you faced that taught you something valuable—about the material, your learning process, or yourself?
3.	How has your understanding of the course material or your approach to learning changed over time?
4.	What grade do you believe best represents your learning and engagement in this course, and why?
5.	What will you take from this course into future classes, work, or personal projects?
